article.title: Protection and improvement of environment and safeguarding of forests and wild life
article.content:
48AProtection and improvement of environment and safeguarding of forests and wild life

Article 48A · Part IV
1[The State shall endeavour to protect and improve the environment and to safeguard the forests and wild life of the country.]

1 Ins. by the Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976, s. 10 (w.e.f. 3-1-1977).
